issues.title: HydraDB retrieval experiment
issues.description: HydraDB combines a typed ontology with semantic retrieval. Customer requirements need grounded source citations.

comments.body: Hybrid search should preserve provenance and isolate each user.

prs.title: Bounded graph filters
prs.body: Use deterministic graph filters before semantic ranking. Fixed read-only templates avoid generated query plans.

comments.body: Keep complete text chunks linked to stable source IDs.

sentences.text: We need semantic search with meeting transcript citations.
Do not merge people just because their names match.
